title: Fix stale promotion mechanics in CLAUDE.md
description: Two lines in CLAUDE.md's Contributing section drifted from live state, discovered while promoting OMARK-50 (PR #96) to main: (1) the promotion push shape still read 'git push origin dev:main' instead of the remote-tracking form the fleet operating model requires (ODOC-193: local dev can be stale on a recycled session); (2) the required-checks paragraph named only 'check . manifests' when gh api repos/opum-ai/opum-marketplace/rules/branches/main shows the ruleset also requires 'Tracker integrity' (confirmed live in .github/workflows/ci.yml:171).

acceptanceCriteria.text: CLAUDE.md documents git push origin origin/dev:main as the promotion push shape, not the bare dev form
CLAUDE.md names both check . manifests and Tracker integrity as required checks on main

finalSummary: Fixed two stale lines in CLAUDE.md's Contributing section: the promotion push shape now reads git push origin origin/dev:main (remote-tracking form, per ODOC-193), and the required-checks paragraph now names both check · manifests and Tracker integrity. Delivered in PR #97, CI run 34979531128 (both checks pass).
